source: FATF and Egmont Group (2020), Trade-Based Money Laundering: Trends and Developments, FATF, Paris. https://www.fatf-gafi.org/en/publications/Methodsandtrends/Trade-based-money-laundering-trends-and-developments.html
what_happened: Fruit exporters received payments from accounts of shell companies in high-risk jurisdictions against fraudulent invoices.
reconstruction: Fairly priced fruit (HS 080410) sold to a shell in a FATF-listed jurisdiction (VG). The third-party payments and fake invoice wording are not in invoice data.
